name: verify greeter fix and fmt gate
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "=== greeter option resolves ===" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.services.displayManager.noctalia-greeter.greeter-args 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -2 && echo "=== any rename warnings left? ===" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -i "renamed" || echo "no rename warnings" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -1 && echo "=== verify gate ===" && nix run .#verify --impure -- --host NIXPC 2>&1 | tail -30
description: confirm greeter rename warning is gone, both hosts evaluate, then run the verify gate
